scripts.check: pnpm check:preflight && pnpm check:rust && pnpm --filter "!@yadaw/dsp-node" --filter "!@yadaw/audio-host-client" -r --if-present check && pnpm test:js && pnpm design:test && pnpm design:build
scripts.check:coverage: pnpm check:preflight:coverage && pnpm format:rust:check && pnpm lint:rust && pnpm test:coverage:prepare && pnpm lint:oxlint && pnpm lint:eslint && pnpm test:coverage:finish && pnpm bench:rust:check && pnpm --filter "!@yadaw/dsp-node" --filter "!@yadaw/audio-host-client" -r --if-present check && pnpm design:test && pnpm design:build
scripts.check:native: pnpm format:rust:check && pnpm lint:rust && pnpm test:rust && pnpm sync:napi-bindings && pnpm test:native-bindings && pnpm --filter @yadaw/desktop test:unit && pnpm --filter @yadaw/project-db test:integration
scripts.check:preflight: pnpm check:version && pnpm sync:napi-bindings && pnpm format:oxfmt:check && pnpm lint:oxlint && pnpm lint:eslint && pnpm lint:design && pnpm check:configs
scripts.check:preflight:coverage: pnpm check:version && pnpm format:oxfmt:check && pnpm lint:design && pnpm check:configs
scripts.check:rust: pnpm format:rust:check && pnpm lint:rust && pnpm test:rust && pnpm bench:rust:check
scripts.check:rust:fast: pnpm format:rust:check && node scripts/cargo-host.ts clippy --workspace --lib --bins --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals -- -D warnings && node scripts/cargo-host.ts test --workspace --lib --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals
scripts.check:rust:coverage: pnpm format:rust:check && pnpm lint:rust && pnpm test:coverage:rust && pnpm bench:rust:check
scripts.bench:rust:check: node scripts/cargo-host.ts bench --workspace --bench mixer_graph --bench render_runtime --bench media_streaming --bench recording --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals --no-run
scripts.bench:rust: node scripts/cargo-host.ts bench --workspace --bench mixer_graph --bench render_runtime --bench media_streaming --bench recording --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals
scripts.bench:rust:quick: node scripts/cargo-host.ts bench --workspace --bench mixer_graph --bench render_runtime --bench media_streaming --bench recording --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals -- --quick
scripts.bench:rust:save: node scripts/cargo-host.ts bench --workspace --bench mixer_graph --bench render_runtime --bench media_streaming --bench recording --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals -- --save-baseline main
scripts.bench:rust:compare: node scripts/cargo-host.ts bench --workspace --bench mixer_graph --bench render_runtime --bench media_streaming --bench recording --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals -- --baseline main
scripts.test:js: pnpm --filter @yadaw/contracts test && pnpm --filter @yadaw/ui test && pnpm --filter @yadaw/project-model test && pnpm --filter @yadaw/desktop test:unit && pnpm --filter @yadaw/project-db test:integration && pnpm test:native-bindings
scripts.test:coverage:js: pnpm --filter @yadaw/desktop test:coverage && pnpm --filter @yadaw/project-db test:coverage && pnpm --filter @yadaw/ui test:coverage && pnpm --filter @yadaw/contracts test:coverage && pnpm --filter @yadaw/project-model test:coverage && node scripts/rewrite-lcov-paths.ts apps/desktop/coverage/lcov.info apps/desktop/ && node scripts/rewrite-lcov-paths.ts packages/project-db/coverage/lcov.info packages/project-db/ && node scripts/rewrite-lcov-paths.ts packages/ui/coverage/lcov.info packages/ui/ && node scripts/rewrite-lcov-paths.ts packages/contracts/coverage/lcov.info packages/contracts/ && node scripts/rewrite-lcov-paths.ts packages/project-model/coverage/lcov.info packages/project-model/
scripts.test:coverage:rust: mkdir -p coverage/rust && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target-coverage cargo llvm-cov --workspace --features yadaw-dsp-node/bench-internals --ignore-filename-regex '(/|^)third_party/' --lcov --output-path coverage/rust/lcov.info
scripts.test:vst3-fixtures: cmake -S . -B target/vst3-fixtures -DYADAW_BUILD_VST3_FIXTURES=ON && cmake --build target/vst3-fixtures/third_party/vst3sdk/public.sdk/samples/vst/again --config Debug --target again && cmake --build target/vst3-fixtures/third_party/vst3sdk/public.sdk/samples/vst/note_expression_synth --config Debug --target note-expression-synth && node scripts/native-build.ts debug binaries && pnpm --filter @yadaw/desktop test:vst3-helper && pnpm --filter @yadaw/desktop test:vst3-editor
